headline: OpenAI merges ChatGPT Chat and Work tabs, pools usage limits
summary: OpenAI is merging ChatGPT's separate Chat and Work tabs, bringing Work features into regular Chat while also combining usage allowances across ChatGPT and Codex and doubling Pro limits. One outlet reports the change will be tested with select users before a broader rollout.
